positions.name: Patrol Leader
positions.description: Elected by patrol members to lead the patrol and represent them in the patrol leaders' council.

positions.name: Senior Patrol Leader
positions.description: The top junior leader in the troop, responsible for running troop meetings and leading the patrol leaders' council.

positions.name: Assistant Senior Patrol Leader
positions.description: Helps the senior patrol leader and fills in when the SPL is absent.

positions.name: Troop Guide
positions.description: Works with new Scouts and helps them learn Scouting skills and earn their early ranks.

positions.name: Den Chief
positions.description: Works with a Cub Scout den, helping with meetings and activities.

positions.name: Scribe
positions.description: Keeps the troop records, including attendance and advancement records.

positions.name: Librarian
positions.description: Keeps track of troop literature, including merit badge pamphlets and other resources.

positions.name: Historian
positions.description: Collects and preserves troop photographs, news clippings, and other historical materials.

positions.name: Quartermaster
positions.description: Keeps track of troop equipment and coordinates its maintenance.

positions.name: Bugler
positions.description: Plays the bugle at troop ceremonies and campouts.

positions.name: Junior Assistant Scoutmaster
positions.description: A Scout at least 16 years old who provides leadership and works with younger Scouts.

positions.name: Chaplain Aide
positions.description: Works with the troop chaplain to provide spiritual guidance and organize religious services.

positions.name: Instructor
positions.description: Teaches Scouting skills to other Scouts.

positions.name: Webmaster
positions.description: Maintains the troop website and online presence.

positions.name: Outdoor Ethics Guide
positions.description: Helps the troop understand and practice Leave No Trace and Tread Lightly! principles.

positions.name: Leave No Trace Trainer
positions.description: Trains other Scouts in Leave No Trace principles and practices.

positions.name: Order of the Arrow Representative
positions.description: Serves as a communication link between the troop and the Order of the Arrow.

positions.name: Assistant Patrol Leader
positions.description: Helps the patrol leader and fills in when the PL is absent. Note: Does not count toward advancement.
